scope: Next five shortest canonical mechanics records after Batch 397

records.name: Chaos Shot
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from the TP Medal Shop. Uncharged input fires Ki Blasts in all directions for 2 hits/10% reported damage; holding concentrates the attack forward for 9 hits/15% reported damage. Current skill evidence identifies Frost as the notable user.

records.name: Innocence Cannon
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super obtained through Majin Buu training. Fires a large straight Ki ball; on hit it deals 30% reported damage and launches the opponent across the map. Current evidence identifies Good Buu's second preset as a notable user.

records.name: Zigzag Express
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super associated with Majin Buu and restricted to Male Majin CaCs. The user spins while creating a small tornado, rushes forward with slight directional control, and the current skill reference reports 10% damage over a four-hit attack. Current evidence also documents PQ85/Villainous Majin Buu as a Xenoverse 2 acquisition route.

records.name: Burst Charge
records.mechanics_notes: Other Super/charge skill from PQ134, Universe 7's Next God of Destruction. Starts charging extremely quickly, then slows as the charge continues; current evidence describes it as most useful for short bursts of roughly two Ki bars. It is usable by CaCs and a broad set of mentors/partners.

records.name: Sauzer Blade
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super from PQ27, Metal Cooler Riot. Creates a Ki blade and performs five tracking slashes for 10% reported total damage; the maintained description states the blade cancels weak Ki Blasts and leaves the opponent airborne briefly for follow-up attacks.

validation.evidence_policy: bounded; current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics/acquisition promoted only where supported; no unsupported probabilities or frame data
